correctness.rationale: A rate-r regenerative resolvent supplies the positive unique stationary density. Away from the reset source, substituting psi=exp(V/(2D))*rho into the steady Fokker-Planck equation gives psi double-prime=Q*psi, where Q=k squared+potential derivative squared/(4D squared)-potential second derivative/(2D). The exact Liouville-Green ansatz has integrable residual O(x^{2alpha-4}) in L^1, allowing a unique positive decaying mode; the growing mode cannot produce an integrable density. The leading eikonal shift is lambda^2 alpha^2 x^{2alpha-2}/(8D^2k); integrating yields the trichotomy. Independent exact derivative/eikonal asymptotic tests passed for alpha 1/3,1/2,2/3,0.82; they support but do not establish x→infinity.
residual_risks: Existence of positive finite amplitude for alpha<=1/2 uses the stated integrable-error WKB theorem and exclusion of growing mode; it is not numerically certified.
